name: my-flow
description: Managed worktrees, one enforced SSH Host, broad local access, and GitHub approval gates.

interface.shortDescription: Managed worktrees with one SSH Host and guarded GitHub publishing.
interface.longDescription: My Flow remembers a target directory and SSH Host alias, restricts Git transport to that alias, refreshes bare repositories at agent startup, auto-allows routine worktree access, and requires explicit approval for GitHub publishing.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this GitHub push approval request.
